About — The Lore

Born Before
the Gate

VALORION was born at that gate. One knight stands alone on a dark plain, sword in hand, white cloak caught in the wind. Above him, the sky tears open — ancient rings of light spin within a storm of blue, violet, and gold, spilling across the horizon like the dawn of a new world.

He could have walked away. Nobody would have blamed him. Instead, he chose the simplest and hardest thing of all: to hold his line.

“He does not run. He does not kneel. He holds the line.” — The Valorion Oath

That is the soul of $VALOR: a community token for those who stay when the storm comes — the early, the patient, and the ones ready for whatever steps through when the portal finally opens.

🛡 The KnightA symbol of the courage to keep standing, even when you stand alone.
🌀 The GateThe blue–violet–gold portal: the great moment everyone is waiting for, together.
🌅 The DawnThe dawn after the storm — for the patient, not the panicked.
⚔ The LineThe line that is never abandoned. That is where the Guardians stand.

STAY

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Has $VALOR launched?
Yes. $VALOR is officially live on the Base network and trades on Uniswap v4 with the VALOR / USDC pair. Its official contract address is 0xf9A372B51592EDE51DE821cB21693f3eB4e2cCcC — and you can track its chart live on DexScreener via the “View Chart” buttons on this page.
Which chain is $VALOR on?
On Base. $VALOR trades on Uniswap v4 with the VALOR / USDC pair. Make sure your wallet is on the Base network before making any transaction.
How do I become a Guardian?
Simply take your place: follow the official announcements, join the community, and live the ethos — stay, wait, ready. The Guardians are the ones who hold their line, from before the gate opens until the dawn arrives.
How can I be sure the $VALOR I buy is the real one?
There's one way: verify the contract address. The only official $VALOR CA on Base is 0xf9A372B51592EDE51DE821cB21693f3eB4e2cCcC. If the address is different — even by a single character — it is not the official token. Do not buy it.
What does “Hold the Line” mean?
It's the knight's oath — and this community's ethos. It means: don't run when things get hard, don't kneel when the pressure comes. Hold your position, stay patient, and face the dawn together. Hold the Line, Face the Dawn.
